slices.focus: Jae-hyun and Min-seo plan domestic trip; short breaks preferred.
slices.summary: With work calmer after autumn's strong finish, Min-seo insists they book a domestic trip before summer. As they compare calendars, Jae-hyun realizes his travel preference has solidified: tightly planned 2-3 day breaks in places like Gyeongju or Jeju feel genuinely restorative, while long overseas travel has lost appeal entirely. He recognizes this as realism, not settling.
open_loops: Ensuring trip doesn't add stress before and after
decisions: Jae-hyun realized he now strongly prefers tightly planned short domestic trips like Gyeongju or Jeju that can fit around
